title: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number o
question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).

prediction.sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
  SELECT
    sr.region_id,
    sr.id AS rep_id,
    sr.name AS rep_name,
    SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total
  FROM web_orders o
  JOIN web_accounts a ON a.id = o.account_id
  JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.id = a.sales_rep_id
  GROUP BY sr.region_id, sr.id, sr.name
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sr.region_id,
    COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
    SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
  FROM web_orders o
  JOIN web_accounts a ON a.id = o.account_id
  JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.id = a.sales_rep_id
  GROUP BY sr.region_id
),
max_rep AS (
  SELECT region_id, MAX(rep_total) AS max_total
  FROM rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id
)
SELECT
  rg.name AS region,
  rs.order_count,
  rs.total_sales,
  rs2.rep_name,
  rs2.rep_total
FROM region_stats rs
JOIN web_region rg ON rg.id = rs.region_id
JOIN rep_sales rs2 ON rs2.region_id = rs.region_id
JOIN max_rep m ON m.region_id = rs.region_id AND m.max_total = rs2.rep_total
ORDER BY rg.name, rs2.rep_name;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
  SELECT r.id AS rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, r.region_id,
         SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total
  FROM web_orders o
  JOIN web_accounts a ON a.id = o.account_id
  JOIN web_sales_reps r ON r.id = a.sales_rep_id
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.region_id
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT r.region_id,
         COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
         SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
  FROM web_orders o
  JOIN web_accounts a ON a.id = o.account_id
  JOIN web_sales_reps r ON r.id = a.sales_rep_id
  GROUP BY r.region_id
),
max_rep AS (
  SELECT region_id, MAX(rep_total) AS max_total
  FROM rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id
)
SELECT rg.name AS region,
       rs.order_count,
       rs.total_sales,
       rs2.rep_name,
       rs2.rep_total
FROM region_stats rs
JOIN web_region rg ON rg.id = rs.region_id
JOIN rep_sales rs2 ON rs2.region_id = rs.region_id
JOIN max_rep m ON m.region_id = rs.region_id AND m.max_total = rs2.rep_total
ORDER BY rg.name, rs2.rep_name;
